answer: Each agent opens terrace export and jetty import gates, locking 70 credits. A walnut crate leaves the terrace with a signed export receipt and reaches the jetty with its pair. The jetty ledger demands inflow equal outflow, burning the bond for an unpaired or reused receipt, so a rented-receipt ring fails, one receipt per pair. Identity k pays 30 plus 8 times k minus 1, so 1,000 fakes pay 4,026,000; an honest trader pays 30 once, bond reclaimed.
